search_notes: Re-check 2026-10-09. FERMATA (BCD-100-5; BCD-100 = prolgolimab, Forteca): no disclosure of the OS analysis found. Registry (API) status unknown, no results, not updated since 2020-09-18. Biocad's own trial page (ct.biocad.ru/en/nozology/bcd-100-5fermata) opened: recruitment complete, study status 'Conducted', no results. Europe PMC by NCT (34 records, reviews), BCD-100-5 (1 review) and FERMATA + prolgolimab (7, none a result), and Crossref titles containing prolgolimab since 2024 (25): phase 3 reports exist for melanoma (OCTAVA, FLAT) and NSCLC (DOMAJOR) but none for cervical cancer; the only cervical report is the single-arm phase 2 CAESURA (ASCO 2023), a sibling trial. Three web searches (two Russian, one English) returned only 2021-2023 items, the latest a Dec 2023 Pharmvestnik note that FERMATA was continuing (search summary, not opened). Not reachable: Biocad news (biocad.ru is script-rendered, its sitemap lists only old posts; eng.biocad.ru did not resolve), the Russian drug register, RUSSCO congress abstracts. A Russian-only disclosure cannot be ruled out, hence medium.

Re-check 2026-10-09. ALIVE (HA114-CSP-003, SKLB1028 = ruserontinib): no interim CR/CRh or OS result, filing or termination notice found. Registry (API) status unknown, no results, not updated since 2021-11-02. CSPC HKEX results announcements read 2021 to Aug 2026: SKLB1028 capsules are listed as an AML 'pivotal trial' up to the 2023 interim results (23 Aug 2023) and are absent from every later document read (2023 annual results of 20 Mar 2024 through 2026 interim results of 20 Aug 2026), with no statement of why. Europe PMC by NCT and SKLB1028 (13 records, latest a 2024 drug-interaction paper and 2026 reviews), Crossref title search and one Chinese web search found no result. Reads as a programme dropped without announcement, but no source says the trial was stopped, so primary_result is left blank rather than terminated_no_analysis. First trace had disclosed = unclear; nothing found hints at a result, so recorded as no. China's CDE trial register was not checked.

Re-check 2026-10-09. SYSA1501-007 (DP303c vs trastuzumab plus vinorelbine or capecitabine): no result, and no sign the trial ever enrolled. Registry (API) still NOT_YET_RECRUITING, estimated start 2023-07, never updated since first posting on 2023-06-13, no results. CSPC HKEX results announcements 2024 to Aug 2026 describe exactly one DP303c phase 3 in HER2-positive breast cancer: initiated Feb 2024, last subject enrolled Apr 2025, topline obtained Aug 2025, presented at SABCS 2025 as 'versus T-DM1' (Crossref: abstract RF6-03, interim analysis). That is the sibling trial SYSA1501-009 / NCT06313086 (registry start 2024-03-13, comparator trastuzumab emtansine), NOT this registry number: do not attach its result here. Europe PMC by NCT (8 reviews) and SYSA1501-007 (0) add nothing. Appears superseded by the T-DM1 trial; no source says so explicitly, so primary_result is left blank.

Re-check 2026-10-09. HC1702-004 (CSPC liposomal daunorubicin-cytarabine vs 7+3, OS primary, 120 planned): no result found. Registry (API) status unknown, no results, not updated since 2023-12-28. Europe PMC by NCT and HC1702-004: 0 records. CSPC HKEX documents read: 'In February 2024, the phase III clinical trial for the treatment of high-risk secondary AML in the elderly patients who have not been previously treated was initiated in China' (2024 interim to 2024 annual results); from Q1 2025 results (29 May 2025) to the 2025 annual report (28 Apr 2026) the only line is 'In April 2025, the database lock was completed for bioequivalence clinical trials conducted in China' in untreated elderly AML, with no outcome; the product is still in the pivotal-trial table of the 2025 annual report and is not mentioned at all in the Q1 2026 or 2026 interim results (20 Aug 2026). The database lock most likely refers to CSPC's separate bioequivalence studies against the reference product (pilot HC1702-BE-001 / NCT04920500 confirmed in the registry; a later 60-patient study seen only in a search summary), not to this OS study, but the documents do not say. One Chinese web search found no result or filing. Bridging design against 7+3: flag for exclusion review.

Re-check 2026-10-09. TQB2450-ALTN-III-01 (benmelstobart + anlotinib maintenance after chemoradiotherapy, limited-stage SCLC): not read out. Sino Biopharm interim results announcement of 19 Aug 2026 (HKEX, https://www1.hkexnews.hk/listedco/listconews/sehk/2026/0819/2026081900298.pdf) says of benmelstobart: 'Phase III clinical trials are currently underway for several other new indications, including maintenance therapy for limited-stage small cell lung cancer'. Sino Biopharm's HKEX announcement titles from 1 Aug to 9 Oct 2026 (26 items) read: no topline for this trial; the 2026 CSCO list (30 Jul 2026) has no limited-stage SCLC phase 3. Registry (API) status unknown, no results, estimated primary completion 2026-09. Europe PMC by NCT: only the phase 2 paper (BMC Cancer 2025) and a review. Beware the sibling readouts of benmelstobart + anlotinib in NSCLC and extensive-stage SCLC (ETER701).

Re-check 2026-10-09: first trace confirmed, no earlier disclosure found. GSK Q1 2025 results announcement issued 30 Apr 2025: 'In April 2025, results showed that the phase III ZEAL-1L trial did not meet its primary endpoint of progression-free survival'; trial table says data reported Q1 2025. Not a stand-alone release. Checked for something earlier: GSK's FY2024 results (5 Feb 2025, read as the 6-K on sec.gov) list ZEAL only as an anticipated H1 2025 phase 3 readout, and EDGAR full-text search finds no GSK filing naming ZEAL-1L between the 20-F of 3 Mar 2025 and the Q1 results of 30 Apr 2025; one web search found no April 2025 release. First HR is the ClinicalTrials.gov results posting of 2026-05-01 (read through the API): HR 1.00 (0.79-1.27), 1-sided p=0.502; same figures in the J Thorac Oncol paper (PubMed date 2026-07-10, doi 10.1016/j.jtho.2026.104087). GSK's study register carries no earlier results; no conference presentation found.

Re-check 2026-10-09. GLS-010-31 (zimberelimab vs chemotherapy, relapsed/refractory classical Hodgkin lymphoma; 60 planned, confirmatory): no result found. Registry (API) status unknown, no results, never updated since 2022-08-26 (was 'not yet recruiting'). Europe PMC by NCT (1 review), GLS-010-31 (0) and zimberelimab + Hodgkin in title (latest: long-term follow-up of the single-arm phase 2 YH-S001-04, Leuk Res 2024, a sibling study); Crossref titles on zimberelimab since 2025 (47) contain no randomised Hodgkin trial. One Chinese web search found no result or conversion to full approval. The sponsor has changed hands: Gloria Pharma's 2025 annual report (cninfo, 28 Apr 2026) says Guangzhou Gloria Biosciences was sold and has been renamed, and neither that report nor the 2026 interim report mentions the drug. The trial may never have started; China's CDE register was not checked.

Re-check 2026-10-09: date and result of the corrected first trace confirmed; HR cells emptied. Roche FY2025 results presentation with pipeline appendix ('Status as of January 29, 2026'), IMpower030 slide (NCT03456063): 'Study did not meet primary endpoint Q4 2025'; the same document lists 'RG7446 Tecentriq + platinum chemo - NSCLC periadj' under 'Removed from phase III'. The preceding document (Q3 2025, status as of 23 Oct 2025, https://assets.roche.com/f/176343/x/a22e1c7d2f/irp251023.pdf) shows the trial with recruitment completed and no result, so the disclosure falls between 23 Oct 2025 and 29 Jan 2026; two web searches found nothing in that window and no Roche release. Data first shown at WCLC 2026 (Seoul): OncLive, News-Medical and Bioengineer items dated 12 Sep 2026 and ASCO Post (14 Sep 2026) opened: median EFS 62.8 vs 34.9 months, 'did not reach the prespecified threshold for statistical significance'. None of the four gives a hazard ratio; the HR 0.77 (0.58-1.02) in the first trace came from a search summary of a paywalled page and could not be confirmed, so the HR cells are blank. Roche's slide says only 'Event-free survival'; IRF assessment is from the registry.
